Title: CIME Expands Cardiovascular Training with Advanced Simulators
NewsSummary: The ANGIO Mentor and Pericardiocentesis Trainers mark a leap forward for CIME's offerings in cardiovascular trainings.
NewsContent:
The Centre for Innovation in Medical Education (CIME) at the Aga Khan University, Karachi, has expanded its simulation offerings with the addition of two high-fidelity cardiovascular simulators: the ANGIO Mentor by Surgical Science and the Pericardiocentesis Trainers by Kyoto Kagaku. This powerful addition to CIME’s simulation arsenal marks a major leap forward in hands-on training for healthcare professionals working in cardiology, interventional radiology, and emergency medicine.

ANGIO Mentor: Revolutionising Endovascular Training

The ANGIO Mentor is a high-fidelity endovascular simulator that offers immersive, hands-on training for a wide range of interventional procedures in a risk-free environment.

Key Features:

  • Realistic Haptics & Imaging: Provides fluoroscopic imaging and tactile feedback for lifelike procedural training.
  • Extensive Case Library: Includes modules for coronary, peripheral, neuro, and structural heart interventions.
  • Team Training Mode: Enables multi-user collaboration, mirroring real catheterization lab dynamics.
  • Performance Metrics: Tracks user proficiency with detailed performance feedback and analytics.

From angioplasty to embolization, the ANGIO Mentor allows learners to rehearse life-saving procedures with zero patient risk, ensuring better preparedness for the clinical setting.

Pericardiocentesis Trainer: Practice for High-Stakes Emergencies

Developed by Kyoto Kagaku, the Pericardiocentesis Trainer provides realistic anatomy and ultrasound-compatible models for practicing this critical emergency procedure.

Key Features:

  • Ultrasound-Guided Needle Insertion: Anatomically correct landmarks for transthoracic and subxiphoid approaches.
  • Fluid Return System: Simulates pericardial effusion with responsive feedback during aspiration.
  • Replaceable Components: Durable, reusable skin and internal structures for repeated practice sessions.

This trainer is ideal for cardiologists, emergency physicians, and intensivists who need to perform pericardiocentesis with precision, speed, and confidence under pressure.

“Simulation is where safety and skill come together. With the addition of these advanced cardiovascular trainers, we continue to provide healthcare professionals with the tools they need to learn, practise, and excel — without risk to patients," said Dr Faisal Ismail, Director, AKU-CIME Pakistan.

Training sessions on the ANGIO Mentor and Pericardiocentesis Trainer can now be scheduled at AKU-CIME, Karachi, through facilitated sessions or self-directed learning. For booking and further informatoon, please contact cime.booking@aku.edu or call 021-34863714.
